  "screen_decision": "exclude",
  "screen_rationale": "The study focuses on methodological issues in animal research (litter effects, statistical analysis, reporting) and does not report a quantitative measure of agreement between animal model results and human clinical outcomes. It discusses the poor translation of animal models but does not quantify it.",
  "arm": "methods-and-bias",
  "arm_evidence": "The study discusses \"improving basic and translational science by accounting for litter-to-litter variation in animal models\" and focuses on \"design and analysis of preclinical studies\".",
  "therapeutic_areas": [
    "psychiatric",
    "neurodegeneration",
    "cross-cutting"
  ],
  "areas_evidence": "The text mentions \"psychiatric, neurodegenerative, and neurodevelopmental disorders\" and discusses general issues in preclinical research applicable across areas.",
  "model_type": "induced",
  "model_evidence": "The study discusses the valproic acid (VPA) model of autism, which is an induced model.",
  "species": [
    "mouse",
    "rat"
  ],
  "species_evidence": "The text explicitly mentions \"typically rodent\" and later refers to \"pregnant female C57BL/6 mice\" and \"rat valproate-induced autism model\".",
  "endpoint_class": "mixed",
  "endpoint_evidence": "The study discusses various outcomes including \"locomotor activity\", \"body weight\", \"marbles buried\", \"anxiety (open field)\", and \"grooming\", which are behavioral and physiological measures."
